1 Flipper: Settings → Authorize phone (60s)\n2 Phone: tap Authorize this phone\n3 Confirm the Bluetooth PIN on both devices
This removes Android’s link key. Also choose Forget phone on the Flipper.
Choose the sending SIM. Only contacts you check are copied to Flipper; inbox and call logs are never read.

Version %1$s

Send to any valid number entered on Flipper while this phone is connected and authorized. No cloud, ads, analytics, stored-inbox access, call logs, or phone-call permission. Link keys are protected by Android Keystore and request IDs prevent accidental duplicate sends.

Download started. Open the Downloads folder when it finishes.

The .fap cannot run on Android. Download it to your phone, send it to your computer, connect the Flipper by USB, close qFlipper, and run one of the commands below.
Move the .fap from phone to computer

USB cable:
1. Connect the phone to the Windows computer.
2. On the phone, open the USB notification and choose File transfer.
3. On Windows, open File Explorer → This PC → your phone → Internal shared storage → Download.
4. Copy flipper_messenger.fap into the computer’s Downloads folder.

Without a cable:
Tap Share downloaded .fap below, choose the file from Downloads, then send it with Quick Share, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, or email. Open or download that file on the computer.
Choose flipper_messenger.fap from the Downloads folder.
The command copies the file to /ext/apps/Tools/flipper_messenger.fap and launches it. On Flipper you can later open Apps → Tools → Flipper Messenger.
